resources: Serverless Framework: the service-file block holding raw CloudFormation
plugins: Serverless Framework: the service-file block listing plugins
HttpApi: SAM: API Gateway v2 event type on a Serverless::Function, and the synthetic id of the implicit HTTP API
Api: SAM: API Gateway v1 event type on a Serverless::Function
RestApi: CloudFormation: API Gateway v1 resource, used as the synthetic id of the implicit REST API
SQS: SAM: event source type on a Serverless::Function
SNS: SAM: event source type on a Serverless::Function
Schedule: SAM: event source type on a Serverless::Function
EventBridgeRule: SAM: event source type on a Serverless::Function
self: Serverless Framework: variable source, a path inside the same document
env: Serverless Framework: variable source, the deploy machine's environment
opt: Serverless Framework: variable source, a CLI option
cf: Serverless Framework: variable source, a CloudFormation stack output
s3: Serverless Framework: variable source, an S3 object
ssm: Serverless Framework: variable source, an SSM parameter
aws: Serverless Framework: variable source, an AWS account value
param: Serverless Framework: variable source, a stage or org parameter
sls: Serverless Framework: variable source, a framework value such as the instance id
file: Serverless Framework: variable source, another file in the service
git: Serverless Framework: variable source, a git value supplied by the git plugin
readable: suss: marker for a service file this reader parses
program: suss: marker for a service file that is a program, which this reader does not run
missing: suss: marker for a path holding no service file
resolved: suss: marker for a reference the document itself answers
symbolic: suss: marker for a reference a deploy supplies, kept as its token
event: suss: marker for a translated event source
abstain: suss: marker for a wiring this reader did not translate
abstained: suss: marker for a wiring this reader did not translate
